biography.characterFamilySituation: Close with extended family on the rez, grandmother is a tribal elder
biography.characterEyes: Deep brown, glow amber when channeling
biography.characterHair: Long black braids with feather and bead ornaments
biography.description: A large, imposing ork woman with traditional Lakota braids and a warm, commanding presence. Bone and turquoise jewelry covers her hands and neck. Her eyes shift to a warm amber glow when she opens herself to the spirit world. Despite her size, she moves with a gentle deliberation.
biography.background: Tala grew up on the Sioux Nation reservation, trained by her grandmother in the ways of the old spirits. A follower of the Bear tradition (mechanically Shamanism), she is a healer first, a warrior when necessary. She came to Seattle's shadows after a corporate mining operation threatened her homeland, seeking both the nuyen and the connections to fight back. She is deeply spiritual and views the shadows as a necessary corruption to protect the sacred.

system.description: A light, concealable pistol. Reliable backup for a shaman who prefers spirits over bullets.
A concealable armored vest worn under clothing.

system.gameEffect: Heals physical damage. Each hit heals one box of physical damage, up to the essence of the target (rounded down).
Stabilizes a dying character, preventing overflow damage and death.
Increases target's Reaction and adds Initiative Dice. Each hit adds +1 Reaction and +1D6 Initiative.
Channels destructive magical energy at a single target, causing Stun damage.
Area-effect version of Stunbolt. Stun damage to all targets in area of effect.
The subject can detect the presence of active foci, sustained spells, and active spirits within range.
Creates a remote viewing sensor at a distant location known to the caster.
Changes the subject's appearance to the caster's specification. Physical illusion, affects cameras and sensors.
Creates a mystical barrier of protection around the subject, adding hits as armor.
Allows the caster to control the thoughts and actions of the target.

system.description: Bear grants +2 dice to health spells and preparations. Bear shamans must make a Composure test not to protect those in danger.
The character has a Sioux Nation SIN.
A turquoise-inlaid bone bracelet that sustains health spells.
system.gameEffect: Sustains a health spell at Force without requiring concentration.

system.description: A raven feather fetish that aids in summoning beast spirits.
system.gameEffect: Adds Force as dice pool bonus to summoning beast spirits.

system.description: A medical kit for field treatment of injuries.
A common and unremarkable sedan. Tala keeps it clean but unostentatious.
Tala's grandmother, a tribal elder and medicine woman on the Sioux rez. Wise, connected, but immobile.
A Sioux wild cat shaman who runs the shadows in Denver. Fellow traditionalist and reliable backup.
A talismonger operating out of a small shop in Tacoma. Supplies reagents, foci, and magical supplies.
A street doc in Redmond. Knows Tala through treating the SINless in the Barrens.
